differences.cause: W326 (#387), finding #47: restoring the converged state after a failed fold location at cycles point 27 changes the subsequent path and finds a second LP. XPPAUT 8.0 leaves the displaced iterate and finds only its first LP. These near-homoclinic cycles at NTST 15 are underresolved; AUTO-07p also finds two mesh-dependent LPs, and at NTST 60 and EPS 1e-9 neither program finds an LP up to period 84.4. This extra point is traced to the restore, not an increased tolerance. docs/auto-references.md.

W437 (#499), finding 73: XPPAUT 8.0 ICPS uses integral(u*upold), while xppautX and AUTO-07p center it on the computed orbit. On this underresolved NTST 15 near-homoclinic branch XPPAUT's first LP has norm 0.4280795, period 64.656143027; the centered discrete equations give norm 0.41805529, period 79.89358, agreeing with AUTO-07p. These mesh-dependent LPs disappear at NTST 60/EPS 1e-9. This deliberate phase-condition difference is recorded in docs/auto-references.md and docs/xppaut-findings.md#73.
